content: {"witnessCode": "import { describe, it } from 'node:test';\\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\\nimport normalizeUrl from '../index.js';\\n\\ndescribe('WWW strip regression', () => {\\n  it('should not strip www for 1-char TLD in base', () => {\\n    const input = 'www.example.a';\\n    const opts = { stripWWW: true };\\n    const result = normalizeUrl(input, opts);\\n    assert.ok(result.includes('www.'), `Expected result to contain 'www.', got ${result}`);\\n  });\\n});"}
